extension.description:
Sign in with your Starz account, browse the full catalogue and play movies and series through InputStream Adaptive with Widevine DRM.
EXPERIMENTAL: Starz provides no public API; this add-on uses the same calls as the Starz website and may need updating when Starz changes them. Movies and series play up to 1080p, also with the software Widevine L3 CDM on desktop (InputStream Adaptive caps the stream at the screen's size); live STARZ is up to 576p.
Features: * Movies, series, episodes, trailers and extras; English and Spanish audio and subtitles * Continue Watching, My List, resume points and watched marks shared with Starz's apps * Genres, categories, filters and sort; search; cast and crew; recommendations * TV Schedule for the STARZ, Encore and Plex channels, and Kodi's TV guide through IPTV Manager * Up Next support and next-episode autoplay * Profiles with parental-control limits; manage devices
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Starz. Use only with your own subscription; third-party clients may be against the service's terms.
